scope: APFS clone of the owner's Claude, Codex and OMP stores; the 135 sources written in its last six hours were cut back to six hours earlier and replayed in 300 s steps by their line timestamps. Each binary built its own index of the cut state, then refreshed after every step (`__work refresh`; this change then ran `__work merge`), ABBA-alternated per step. Query cases ran afterwards as fresh processes, ABBA-interleaved, each binary on its own index.

query_cost_of_segments.note: one binary, a copy of each index against the same copy merged to one segment per table, --no-auto

simulated_caps.note: FTS5 level merges (usermerge=2) plus the cap, replaying which refreshes added a segment 40 times over (2920 rounds); large-segment rewrites at the measured 2.9 s prose, 5.2 s tools, 0.24 s lexicon
